metadata.title: CMIP6 NEX-GDDP 2040 projection -- Jashpur, Chhattisgarh
metadata.source: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 (bias-corrected, ~25km downscaled), via Google Earth Engine
metadata.spatial_unit: real Survey of India district polygon (reduceRegions mean, 25km scale)
metadata.resolution: ~25km (NEX-GDDP native grid) -- coarser than a district in most cases; not valid at block/village scale
metadata.hot_day_definition: hot_days_tmax_ge40_per_yr = mean number of March-June days per year with daily Tmax >= 40 degC. This is a HOT-DAY COUNT, NOT the IMD heatwave-event definition used for this portal's observed IMD indices (which also requires a >= 4.5 degC departure from the day-of-year normal and a run of >= 2 consecutive qualifying days). The two are an order of magnitude apart and must not be compared.
metadata.max_index_definition: max_summer_tmax and rx1day_mm are the MEAN OF THE PER-YEAR MAXIMA (ETCCDI TXx / Rx1day convention), not the single maximum over the whole window -- the latter grows with window length and made the 10-year-future vs 15-year-baseline delta a window-length artefact.
